title: GTA+
headline: GTA+
subtitle: This Month’s Benefits
content:
In addition to the recurring monthly GTA$500,000 deposited directly into your Maze Bank account, GTA+ Members who've signed up for this month (September 10–October 7) will also receive:

— The new Pegassi Horus (Super)
— 60% off Biker Business Properties, Upgrades, and Modifications
— The Bigness Patchwork Revere Collar shirt and Jeans
— 3X GTA$ and RP on Bike Service Missions
— And more

Membership automatically renews monthly, cancel anytime. Visit rsg.ms/gtaplus for more info.
